items.d: The home arena of the city's KHL outfit, HC 'Admiral', refer to the KHL calendar for the game days; also provides spaces for concerts, exhibitions and other gigs.
Local history museum administered by the museum in Sisimiut.

This is one amazing location in summer! Set in the northern tip of the Atacama salt pan, this location offers a splendid panorama of the Andes, and the possibility to bathe in waters as salty as those of the Dead Sea, meaning you…
A pedestrian street with several 17th- to 20th-century buildings, interesting doors and special windows.

Guided rafting trips on the Arno through the historic centre, passing beneath Ponte Vecchio. Tours last about one hour, require no previous experience and are run in inflatable rafts with an instructor in each boat.
A museum dedicated to the history and advancement of human rights in Panama and around the world. Displays are all in Spanish but tours in English can be arranged in advance.
The administrative center of Shingon Buddhism. Various Buddhist activities are offered at the hall such as copy scriptures and meditation.
Small aquarium with a few local and exotic fish. Very small aquarium with limited information, not worth the high price for foreigners, but Jordanians (1 JD) might want to take their kids.
For a century this was the "T-word" in Belfast, even more than the Troubles, an unwelcome reminder of a catastrophe reflecting badly on the city.
The old school building which opened its doors in 1936. One part of the exhibit is about the elementary school depicting how life was in the first school to open its doors in the Chaco wilderness.
Closed to non-Muslims.
Part of a Ukrainian Greek Catholic monastery, and mostly built in the early 17th century.
Half-destroyed palace built in 17th century to be king's summer residence.
See the historic Roman Catholic church, Spanish-style recreational plaza, and the municipal buildings surrounded by streets and shops.
Mountain peak Ćurevac is a great point for panoramic mountain views.
A church with impressive large dome. You need a passport to get in.
A small village on the edge of the park.
A monastery site of Theravada Buddhism.
South Korea's pompous propaganda palace faces the demarcation line. Visitors are usually taken to the Peace Pagoda next to it, which provides good views of the JSA and surrounding countryside.
Safari with African species, kayaking, waterfalls, zip-lines.

Unusual museum owned by the Lo Heng Mong motorbike shop. In business for more than 50 years, the business has kept an example of most motorcycles they have sold over that period. Most motorcycles are small-displacement scooters.
Has one of the largest collections of musical instruments in Europe.
The bathing complex by the lake has a large outdoor pool and an indoor pool.

Opened at the end of 2009, the construction of this building led to numerous allegations of corruption. The design is supposed to represent Trinidad's national flower but it has been much criticised as being out of keeping with…
Born from the massive 1886 eruption of Mt Tarawera, this is the world’s newest geothermal eco-system, and an exciting and dramatic destination that the whole family can enjoy.

Though the gardens are a part of the more than three hundred and fifty acre grounds (61 ha) of the large royal home known as the Muntazah Palace, the Montazah Royal Gardens take up more than half of the property.
This small pond at the east end of Sanjō-dōri with Nara Park behind or Naramachi to its south is a very popular viewing spot for Kōfukuji.
Models and sculptures of angels - cute, moving or emetic as the mood takes you.
A memorial erected in 2006 to celebrate the city's 2700th anniversary.
A dam was built in the 1970s for hydroelectricity production, and the artificial lake is surrounded by beautiful mountains. Trout is cultivated in many places around the lake.

Songgot-bong is a sharp, pointed peak on the northwestern coast of Ulleungdo known for its dramatic cliffside appearance. Its name literally means “awl peak,” reflecting its needle-like silhouette rising from the sea.
Liqenat refers to two picturesque alpine lakes. The name derives from the Albanian word liqen (singular: lake) and liqenat (plural: lakes)

Built between 1799 and 1860 this is the parish that gives the original name to the district. Very popular among local people from all the city that comes to pray to San Expedito, Saint of impossible causes.
Romanesque church dating from the 12th century. It is obligatory to reserve by phone.

Located on the site of the remains of an old Byzantine monastery and church above the village of Al Safi. The cave is believed to be the one Lot took refuge in with his two daughters when God according to the Bible destroyed…

Built on the site of the former city fortifications, this star-shaped park is the oldest public garden in Germany. It features scenic walking paths, colorful flowerbeds, and the historic "Am Wall" windmill.
Sightseeing ride.
Indoor swimming facilities, including water slide, swimming pool, hot water pool and diving towers. Next door there are several other rather dry sports facilities. Open all year.

The medina house of a local governor in the past, this house with 18 rooms belonged to him and his 4 wives and 21 children. Extremely beautiful and intricate interior, on the outside unassuming and signposted as 'Tapis-Sabra'.
